name: attachment
useFor: Use for files sent with a message or attached to an order: receipts, invoices, exports. Set state to idle, uploading, processing, error or done; add AttachmentActions with AttachmentAction keys (remove, retry, download) and AttachmentTrigger to open the file. Line several up in AttachmentGroup.
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (card.tsx small card, the merchant tiles, mono figures)
